aggregation: Candidate minus optimized. First average comparable seeds within each layout, then equally weight observed layout means, including incomplete layouts for descriptive means only. Preserve every planned arm and pair in denominators. Relative throughput uses the ratio of these means, not mean paired ratios. No new tests, confidence intervals, policy runs, or recommendations are computed.
